courses.title: Weekly Qigong Classes in the Adelaide Park Lands
courses.description: Sarah's regular outdoor group classes in Adelaide's Park Lands, at Veale Gardens and Hurtle Square/Tangkaira. Each class builds a repertoire of White Tiger Qigong forms, breathing practices and meditation, and newcomers are welcome. Classes run in seasonal terms on weekday evenings and Saturday mornings.

courses.title: Weekly Online Qigong Classes on Zoom
courses.description: Live White Tiger Qigong classes taught over Zoom, so you can practise with Sarah from home. Sessions combine flowing movement, breathwork and meditation, and run in seasonal terms on weekday mornings and afternoons.

courses.title: Personal Qigong Training Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one qigong sessions with Sarah, in person in Adelaide or over Zoom, for beginners and experienced practitioners alike. Sessions are shaped around your own goals, and she gives you practices and ways to track your progress.

courses.title: NEWCASTLE: Awaken Your Vitality: A New Year Qigong Renewal
courses.description: A New Year Qigong workshop at Blackbutt Nature Reserve Community Hub in Newcastle, NSW, led by Sarah on a visit from Adelaide. Choose a restorative morning session or a full day that adds energising White Tiger Qigong practices, meditation and intention-setting in the afternoon.
courses.price: From $70 AUD (morning, early bird); full day $155 AUD

notes: Content for an existing listing (White Tiger Qigong batch, 30 Oct 2026); researched under the usual ingestion rules.

Left out at review: the Bamboo Body video ("keep your spine young" is a body claim); four short-dated term series that repeat the weekly classes; the recorded sessions (access ends Jan 2027). Evergreen only.

Videos: Sarah has no channel of her own. All 15 videos are on the White Tiger Qigong YouTube channel (@WhiteTigerQigong), in its playlist titled 'Sarah Divine' (PLzJnuN0-FwW05ESwVsOMjKE3wSejhcE6E), and each description names Sarah as the teacher. Several are embedded on her own site. All 15 return 200 from oEmbed. Sorted by views (5,066 down to 624). Emoji were stripped from two titles. If the White Tiger Qigong listing later takes videos from the same channel, check for duplicates (its audit JSON has none at present).

Videos left out: 'Intro To Immunity Boosting Qigong' (a health claim). The playlist also holds about 25 other videos whose descriptions are White Tiger's generic text and do not name the teacher; the playlist is not only hers, since '7 Minute Qigong for Neck & Shoulder Tension' is led by Mai Soto. Those were left out as unverified. Several would fail the health-claim rule anyway (eyesight, anxiety, depression, wrist pain, brain health). 'The Physiology Behind Qigong' (16K views) looks from its thumbnail like Sarah teaching, but nothing in the text confirms it.

Weekly Park Lands and Zoom classes: her homepage lists 'Spring 2026 offerings' (in person on Saturday mornings and Wednesday/Thursday evenings, with Wednesday intermediate by invitation; online on Wednesday mornings and Thursday/Saturday afternoons), but gives no price and no booking page for an ongoing weekly class. They went in undated, as 'Contact for pricing', linking to the homepage. The dated term series (Flow into Summer, Three Saturdays, Unwind & Renew) are the bookable forms of these classes right now, so they overlap with the two undated items.

Private sessions: the homepage describes 'Personal Qigong Training Sessions' year-round but shows no price. The $130 AUD comes from a Humanitix ticket on the Newcastle event: 'Private Coaching Session (via Zoom) ... (normally $130)'. The in-person rate is not published.
Free Summer Flow (City of Adelaide grant) went in as a dated free course, not a free resource, because it is a live class series that needs registration.

Left out as past: The Inner Current retreat (Adelaide Hills, 8–11 October 2026; now full, with a register-interest form for future retreats); the Perth double workshop (21 July 2024); 'Flow, Focus & Feel Fantastic' (Hurtle Square, 2025).
Free resources: none. The site's Videos and Podcast pages have no content in the page source, and the blog's last post was August 2020. The free YouTube material is listed under videos.

Prices and dates come from each Humanitix event's structured data (AUD) and its description. Dates for the recorded series on Humanitix are placeholders ('dates given are arbitrary'), so the item has only the access end date, 2027-01-31.
